text:
Maria Gomez: Heads up — our Feb billing export shows about $18,421.17 of untagged GPU spend concentrated on the prod-dedicated cluster. Appears split across a few projects; we need to attribute before month close so chargebacks + budgets are accurate.

Ajay Patel: Do you have the raw BigQuery rows or project ids? I can run a join with our ownership table.

Maria Gomez: Quick extract pasted below — main offending project ids: redwood-experiments, customer-acme-project, infra-ml-sandbox. I flagged redwood-experiments as likely ENG-RESEARCH.

Leo Chen: We can backfill tags via billing export. Example query to get invoice-level GPU rows:
```sql
SELECT invoice_month, project.id AS project_id, sku.description AS sku, usage_start_time, cost, labels
FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_exports.gce`
WHERE sku.description LIKE '%GPU%' AND invoice_month = '2026-02' AND (labels IS NULL OR labels = '{}')
```
One-liner to push tag to cost system (internal API):
```bash
bq query --use_legacy_sql=false '
  "SELECT project.id, SUM(cost) AS untagged_cost FROM `redwood-billing.gcp_exports.gce` WHERE sku.description LIKE \"%GPU%\" AND invoice_month=\"2026-02\" AND (labels IS NULL OR labels = \"{}\") GROUP BY project.id"' \
  --format=prettyjson | jq -r '.[] | "curl -X POST https://cost-api.internal/v1/backfill -H \"Authorization: Bearer $COST_TOKEN\" -d @-"' | sh
```
This will create backfill jobs that mark the charge and assign team tag based on our ownership mapping.

Priya Rao: Can we also flip on enforcement so future compute without a tag is routed to a temporary budget hold and an auto-email sent to owners? We should avoid repeated manual backfills.

Dan Blake: +1. Recommend: (1) daily alert for any project that racks > $200/day untagged to #eng-sre and finance, (2) short budget hold (48h) for projects > $1k untagged in a billing period, (3) automated owner ping with link to remediation doc. I can add it to the alerting runbook and PR the policy.

billing-bot: Automated chargeback report generated for period 2026-02-01 to 2026-02-28. Untagged GPU spend total: $18,421.17. Report: https://billing.internal/reports/1824567890 (permissioned).

Maria Gomez: Thanks — Ajay, can you run the backfill script and confirm when the cost-api jobs complete? Dan/Priya, please draft the enforcement rule and the alert thresholds; finance will sign off on the hold policy. I'll update the Feb allocation sheet after backfill.

Ajay Patel: On it. Running backfill now, ETA EOD. Will paste job ids and results here when done. :thumbsup:

Leo Chen: If you want a quick script to map projects -> owners, use our ownership CSV in /infra/ownership/projects.csv. I can add it to the backfill job so tags are accurate.

Maria Gomez: Perfect. Let's aim to close allocation by tomorrow morning so invoicing is clean.

Ajay Patel: Backfill jobs submitted: job-33721, job-33722, job-33723. I'll follow up with status updates.

Dan Blake: I started the alert PR: https://git.internal/alerts/pull/452 — sets the daily $200 untagged threshold and routes to #eng-sre and finance. Comments welcome.

Maria Gomez: Great work, team. I'll take the chargeback spreadsheet and notify sales for any customer-attributed spend that needs invoicing adjustments.

Ajay Patel: Confirmed: job-33721 completed, job-33722 in progress, job-33723 queued. Will update once all done.
